AEAT's published schemas (tikeV1.0) used by xml_test.go to validate generated records. The XMLDSig import in
SuministroInformacion.xsd points at the local copy of the W3C schema so the test runs offline.
Source: https://prewww2.aeat.es/static_files/common/internet/dep/aplicaciones/es/aeat/tikeV1.0/cont/ws/
